title: dispatch content file
description: A report: this happened (§4.1). Raised after the fact, queued, never waited on, and it offers nothing — what to do about it is the player's to deduce and the player's to buy. There is deliberately no `offers` field; adding one rebuilds the Precedent, which is the shape §4.1 records as wrong.

prio.description: Queue order, highest first. The feed is capped at 4.

once.description: The whole cooldown model. `run` for a pattern that should keep being reported while it keeps happening; `profile` for a first-time measurement. A dispatch that can fire twice a run is one that will.

when.description: expr tree (§11.6). The ONLY place `signalCount`, `signalSince` and `hasTenet` are legal — everywhere else they are a validation error, which is what keeps combat independent of save history (§4.3).

title.description: Interpolates the same three forms the body does.

body.description: A measurement with words around it. Interpolates {signalCount:name}, {signalTotal:name} and {last:name.field}. It must not recommend, and it must not name a tenet: the test is whether two players could read it and reasonably do different things.
